items.title: Polaris: Coupled Orbital Polar Embeddings for Hierarchical Concept Learning
items.title_zh: Polaris：用于层次概念学习的耦合轨道极坐标嵌入
items.summary: Polaris is a polar hyperspherical embedding framework that separates semantics from hierarchy using angular geometry and radius, combined with local constraints, global regularization and uncertainty-aware asymmetric objectives. Across taxonomy-expansion settings including trees, multi-parent DAGs and multimodal hierarchies, it reports gains of up to about 19 points in top-K retrieval and up to 60% lower mean rank over fourteen baselines.

items.title: Are Tools All We Need? Unveiling the Tool-Use Tax in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 工具就是全部所需吗？揭示 LLM 智能体中的工具使用税
items.summary: The paper shows that tool-augmented reasoning does not necessarily beat native chain-of-thought when semantic distractors are present, and uses a factorized intervention framework to separate prompt-formatting cost, tool-calling protocol overhead and the gain from actually executing tools. It finds that under semantic noise tool gains often fail to offset the "tool-use tax" introduced by the protocol, and its G-STEP inference-time gate yields only partial recovery, suggesting deeper gains require stronger intrinsic reasoning and tool-interaction capabilities.

items.title: AI-Enabled Question-Answering for Chartered Accountancy: A Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning Framework
items.title_zh: 面向特许会计的 AI 问答：检索增强推理框架
items.summary: CA-ThinkFlow is a parameter-efficient RAG framework pairing a 14B, 4-bit-quantized DeepSeek-R1 reasoning model with layout-aware Docling extraction that preserves document structure, inserting retrieved context into the prompt while relying on the model's built-in chain-of-thought. On the multi-level CA-Ben benchmark its Scholastic Reliability Coefficient was equal to 68.75% of the results achieved by GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet, though the authors note that reasoning over complex regulatory texts such as taxation remains a weakness.

items.title: Agentic AI for Trip Planning Optimization Application
items.title_zh: 智能体式 AI 出行规划优化应用
items.summary: The paper presents an agentic framework in which an orchestration agent coordinates specialized traffic, charging and points-of-interest agents to refine trip plans, plus the Trip-planning Optimization Problems Dataset, which supplies definitive optimal solutions and category-level task structure. The system reaches 77.4% accuracy on the TOP Benchmark, significantly outperforming single-agent and workflow-based multi-agent baselines.

items.title: ViLegalNLI: Natural Language Inference for Vietnamese Legal Texts
items.title_zh: ViLegalNLI：面向越南语法律文本的自然语言推理
items.summary: ViLegalNLI is described as the first large-scale Vietnamese natural-language-inference dataset for the legal domain, with 42,012 premise-hypothesis pairs from official statutory documents labeled as entailment or non-entailment. It was built with a semi-automatic pipeline using LLMs for controlled hypothesis generation plus cross-model validation, and experiments show few-shot LLM configurations performing best while hypothesis length, lexical overlap and reasoning complexity strongly affect results.

items.title: Why Do LLMs Struggle in Strategic Play? Broken Links Between Observations, Beliefs, and Actions
items.title_zh: 为什么 LLM 在策略博弈中表现不佳？观测、信念与行动之间的断裂
items.summary: Experiments with Llama 3.1, Qwen3 and gpt-oss identify two gaps in LLM decision-making in incomplete-information games: an observation-belief gap, where internal representations of latent states are more accurate than verbal reports but brittle under multi-hop reasoning and drift from Bayesian coherence, and a belief-action gap, where acting optimally on decoded beliefs would improve payoffs in about 95% of games. The authors argue these systematic vulnerabilities warrant caution before deploying LLMs in strategic domains without robust guardrails.

items.title: Ontos-AI/knowhere
items.title_zh: Ontos-AI/knowhere：为 AI 智能体与 RAG 输出结构化分块
items.summary: Knowhere is a Python tool that extracts, parses and outputs structured chunks ready for AI agents and RAG pipelines.

items.title: StartupHakk/OpenMonoAgent.ai
items.title_zh: StartupHakk/OpenMonoAgent.ai：本地 LLM 驱动的终端编程智能体
items.summary: OpenMonoAgent.ai is a beta, terminal-native coding agent powered by local LLMs, billed as fully open source, free forever and installable with a single command; it is written in C#/.NET.
